findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 233 requests to 70 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 25.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.1 MB (12%) came from third-party domains, 1.3 MB of it from services classified as tracking (171 requests).

47 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), aniview.com (Aniview, advertising), bfmio.com (Beachfront, advertising).
144 cookies were set by third-party domains (176 cookies in total).
